# Detection models in the MX3 frequency matrix (300 / 400 MHz)

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen_detection_summary.ps1 from references/tx8-freq-matrix.csv. Do not edit by hand; re-run the script. -->

Source: MemryX reference table (`model_inference_results_by_frequency.xlsx`), config 4x1 = **4 MX3 chips**.
**This is NOT TX8 data**: fps is accelerator throughput measured by MemryX on their host; TX8
(4x Cortex-A53) must re-verify end-to-end fps, latency and power (skill `mx3-runtime-integration`).

Cells: `fps / module power mW`; `NG` = failed or no record at that clock; `n/a` = row missing. Rule column = lowest PASS clock <= 400 MHz with fps >= 30 x 1.5 = 45 (target 30 fps).
Task: `detect` = axis-aligned boxes, `obb` = oriented boxes (name heuristic). 160 models listed, 131 pass the rule.
Licenses and NMS-free flags: see `detector-catalog.md`. For other targets run `scripts/freq_query.ps1`.
